# THERMOTECH ENGINEERING

> Manufacturer of industrial hot-water and steam boilers rated 5–25 MW. Water-tube and fire-tube designs, ISO 9001 / ISO 45001 certified, GOST conformity. Packaged units for district heating, process plants and combined-heat-and-power.

## Products
### TT-HW-05 — Hot-water boiler
- Output: 5 MW
- Design pressure: 1.6 MPa
- Working fluid: 115 / 70 °C (supply / return)
- Net efficiency: 94 %
- Fuels: Natural gas, Diesel, Light fuel oil
- Combustion control: Modulating burner, 25–100 % turndown
- Feedwater: Single-stage deaerator + feed pump
- Automation: PLC, Modbus TCP / BACnet
- Footprint: 6.4 × 3.2 m
- Dry weight: ≈ 18 t
- Certification: ISO 9001, ISO 45001, GOST conformity

### TT-HW-12 — Hot-water boiler
- Output: 12 MW
- Design pressure: 2.5 MPa
- Working fluid: 150 / 70 °C (supply / return)
- Net efficiency: 95 %
- Fuels: Natural gas, Diesel, Heavy fuel oil, Biomass
- Combustion control: Modulating burner, 20–100 % turndown
- Feedwater: Dual-stage deaerator + redundant feed pumps
- Automation: PLC, Modbus TCP / BACnet
- Footprint: 9.2 × 4.1 m
- Dry weight: ≈ 34 t
- Certification: ISO 9001, ISO 45001, GOST conformity

### TT-ST-25 — Steam boiler
- Output: 25 MW
- Design pressure: 3.9 MPa
- Working fluid: 3.9 MPa / 450 °C superheated steam
- Net efficiency: 96 %
- Fuels: Natural gas, Heavy fuel oil, Coal, Biomass
- Combustion control: Modulating burner, 20–100 % turndown
- Feedwater: Deaerator + variable-speed feed pump + economizer
- Automation: PLC, Modbus TCP / BACnet
- Footprint: 14.0 × 6.0 m
- Dry weight: ≈ 72 t
- Certification: ISO 9001, ISO 45001, GOST conformity

## Certifications
- ISO 9001 — Quality management system
- ISO 45001 — Occupational health & safety management
- GOST conformity — Pressure-equipment declarations, hydrostatic test certificates
- EN 12953 / EN 12952 — Shell/fire-tube and water-tube construction standards (design basis)

## FAQ
- Q: What output range do THERMOTECH boilers cover?
  A: Our standard product line spans 5 to 25 MW of thermal output across three models: the TT-HW-05 (5 MW), the TT-HW-12 (12 MW) and the TT-ST-25 (25 MW). Each model is engineered as a fully packaged unit rather than a field-assembled plant, which shortens delivery time and simplifies commissioning.
- Q: Which fuels can the units burn?
  A: Every model ships with a modulating burner sized for natural gas or light fuel oil. The TT-HW-12 and TT-ST-25 can additionally be configured for diesel, heavy fuel oil or biomass. Fuel selection is fixed at order time because it drives burner sizing, flue-gas treatment and automation logic.
- Q: How are the boilers certified?
  A: Manufacturing runs under an ISO 9001 quality-management system and an ISO 45001 occupational-health-and-safety system. Units intended for markets that require national standards are supplied with GOST conformity documentation, including pressure-equipment declarations and hydrostatic test certificates.
- Q: What does a typical lead time look like?
  A: Standard configurations ship in 12 to 16 weeks from a confirmed purchase order. Non-standard builds — custom pressures, alternative fuels or special automation — typically add four to six weeks. We confirm a firm date during the quotation stage.
- Q: Do you provide commissioning and service support?
  A: Yes. Every supply includes remote commissioning guidance, on-site start-up assistance on request, operator training and a two-year warranty covering parts and labour. A spare-parts catalogue and a priority response contract are available for the full service life of the unit.
